s1.text: Wood stove label: still send CPSC one?

s2.text: Say she's mailed copies for years. Since September twenty-first, twenty twenty-six, that section is gone.

s3.text: Here's the catch. The notice on the stove itself still has to be there.

s4.text: So she skips the mailing and checks her label: clearances, floor protection, chimney type.

s5.text: Comment M and Z, we'll DM you the free CPSC finder.
